title: Listed coordinates are free
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\eta$ assign one of the three restriction states to each of the $n$ coordinates, and let $L$ be a list of coordinates. Every coordinate belonging to $L$ is free in the assignment obtained by making the coordinates in $L$ free.
hypotheses_covered: $\eta$ is a restriction assignment on $n$ coordinates
